conclusion: Originals, supplements, and an original-generation 2016 kit manual independently cross-checked; published K562 100 mM-versus-100 µM discrepancy exposed on page. The manual establishes ligation-free workflow and index family but does not print proprietary RT/TSO bases or identify the study-specific revision and indexes. The TT-TimeLapse K562 branch cites Duffy et al. 2015 MTS-biotin enrichment; that predecessor original and figure supplement were checked, while linked workbooks and any distinct detailed protocol still need retrieval and second review.
